sent.text: Hi Ceci, "choking hazard" on a toy label means it has small parts that could block a child's airway if put in the mouth. A "choking hazard" warning means the toy has small parts that could block a child's airway if they put it in their mouth. It's to tell you it's not safe for young children who still mouth toys, usually under 3 years. Check the age on the label and pick one that's right for your nephew's age.

A "choking hazard" label means the toy has small parts that could block a small child's airway if put in their mouth. It's a standard warning, usually to keep it away from children under 3 years old. For a birthday gift for your nephew, just check the age range on the box matches his age.
